records.detail: The Banque Centrale de Mauritanie publishes a Rapport d'audit for 2025 on its own site. The independent auditor's report on the financial statements at 31 December 2025 is addressed to the President of the Bank's Conseil General, says the engagement was given to the auditor by that Council, and is signed in Tunis on 18 May 2026 by Grant Thornton Tunisie, a member of Grant Thornton International, with Elmoez Ben Amor as partner. The opinion is unqualified: the statements give a faithful picture under IFRS. The accounts show a balance sheet total of 131,274,381,414 MRU and comprehensive income of 4,048,874,109 MRU. Two things are worth noting beyond the name. The auditor is not in Mauritania: the firm signs from Tunisia, so the bank's accounts are audited across a border. And it is the second central bank on this map inside the Grant Thornton network, after Ethiopia, whose auditor MSE Audit Service LLP also signs as a Grant Thornton member firm. The bank's own governance section lists a single external auditor alongside its audit committee, and no second firm appears anywhere in the report.
records.source_title: Banque Centrale de Mauritanie, Rapport d'audit BCM 2025 — Rapport de l'auditeur independant relatif aux etats financiers arretes au 31 Decembre 2025
